title: I rose from the ranks, sir, and I’m proud of it.
html_source: Molly’s father was in the military in Gibraltar. He didn’t go in the army with a commission, he earned it. A rare thing in the British Army, he was a man who rose from the ranks into being an officer. They were called rankers (and that is how Bloom thinks of him a few lines ahead).
